verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a first-party log streaming service that exports tenant logs in near real-time. That is a form of event stream that could carry auth activity, but the evidence frames it only as export to a log analysis service. Actions are a developer building block for customizing flows, not a subscription mechanism, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented registrable outbound HTTP webhook/stream endpoints for arbitrary consumers, explicit coverage of sign-up/sign-in/user-change event types, payload/delivery guarantees for sync use cases, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to webhooks or event streams for auth events (sign-ups, sign-ins, user changes) to keep my systems in sync

citations.quote: Auth0’s log streaming service allows you to export tenant logs to a log analysis service.
Describes how to export your logs in near real-time using log streaming.
You can choose the content type and form and preview the payload using the Auth0 Dashboard.
